text: Affine selection is no longer a NiftiHeader preferredAffine convenience. Decode uses PreferSform, PreferQform, RequireAgreement(tolerance), or UseExplicit and returns NiftiAffineSelection with source plus qform/sform disagreement diagnostics while retaining the original header. Fourth-axis seconds/milliseconds/microseconds become regular Time coordinates; unknown units are Ordinal, Reject, or an explicit assumed time unit.
